commits.message:
fix: stop loading creme-filling.md in oro-run; update model IDs

- Remove creme-filling.md from constructPrompt in oro-run — it belongs
  to oro-generate/oro-feedback (PRD generation), not task execution.
  Loading 250K+ tokens of rules per task was the main cost driver.
- Remove dead rulesContent/maxContext truncation code (was computed but
  never applied —  was used instead of )
- Update Bedrock SONNET to us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (Sonnet 4.6)
- Update README model table to reflect Sonnet 4.6
- Add AZURE_AI_API_KEY/BASE to clearProviderEnv for non-OpenAI Azure models
- aider: add azure_ai/ support in run-with-aider.sh and model config

fix: aider provider improvements for oro-feedback and oro-run

oro-feedback:
- Add buildAiderFeedbackPrompt() — skips tool-use instructions since Aider
  has no file tools with --no-git; outputs pure markdown to stdout
- Use it when provider === 'aider' instead of the Claude-specific prompt
- Capture stdout and write to cookie-crumbs.md on exit (same pattern as
  oreo-generate.js), including diff-marker cleanup

oro-run:
- Add extractFilesFromTask() helper that parses **Files:** section from
  task details
- Pass parsed files as --file args to Aider on each spawn, preventing the
  "please add these files to the chat" ask that wastes attempt 1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: use pure markdown stdout capture for oro-generate aider provider

Replace --file diff approach with buildAiderGeneratePrompt() that asks Aider
to output pure markdown directly to stdout. Oroboreo captures and writes
cookie-crumbs.md, eliminating diff conflict markers and ensuring the session
name is always set correctly from the first line.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: aider provider for oro-generate and oro-feedback

- Save aider credentials before clearProviderEnv() to prevent loss across retries
- Pass cookie-crumbs.md as --file arg so Aider can write to it directly
- Add AIDER_NO_GIT=1 for generate/feedback to skip repo scanning
- Support AIDER_READ_FILES env var for read-only context files
- Map AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT from AZURE_API_BASE in run-with-aider.sh
- Extract markdown from Aider stdout as fallback if file write fails

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
chore: fix bin paths and repo url in package.json (remove ./ prefix)

feat: add aider provider support to oro-generate and oro-feedback

Both commands now support AI_PROVIDER=aider, routing architect tasks
through AIDER_MODEL_OPUS (azure/o3) via run-with-aider.sh.

All three oroboreo commands (oro-run, oro-generate, oro-feedback) now
work fully with the aider provider.

chore: fix bin permissions and bump to 1.2.2

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: add Aider provider for Azure OpenAI and local model support

Adds AI_PROVIDER=aider as a fifth provider option, enabling Oroboreo to
run on any model available through Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or local Ollama
instead of being locked to Claude Code / Anthropic.

- utils/run-with-aider.sh (new): spawns Aider in non-interactive batch
  mode with --edit-format diff, --no-detect-urls, --no-auto-commits, and
  --map-tokens 0 to prevent context overflow on large repos
- utils/oreo-config.js: three-tier model routing via AIDER_MODEL_OPUS,
  AIDER_MODEL_SONNET, AIDER_MODEL_HAIKU (falls back to AIDER_MODEL);
  clears aider vars in clearProviderEnv()
- utils/oreo-run.js: aider provider validation, credential saving across
  retries (skip clearProviderEnv for aider), auto-mark task complete when
  Aider exits 0 with confirmed file edits, script selection logic
- .env.example: Option 5 section with Azure, OpenAI, and Ollama examples
  for three-tier routing

Tested on Azure AI Services with gpt-5.4 (SONNET), gpt-5.4-mini (HAIKU),
and o3 (OPUS). Completes full 5-task session autonomously with git commits.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: Buffer.match crash when PR already exists

execSync errors have stderr as Buffer, not string.
Calling .match() on a Buffer throws 'match is not a function'.
Added .toString() before regex matching.
chore: clean stale project progress from package template

fix: PR creation shell interpolation + handle existing PR for auto-merge

- Use --body-file instead of --body to avoid shell interpreting backticks in PR body
- Catch 'PR already exists' from gh pr create and continue to merge step
- Clean up temp body file after PR creation

feat: add --auto flag to oro-generate for non-interactive workflows

- Added --auto, --yes, and -y flag support
- Auto-confirms new-prompt.md usage when flag is present
- Prevents interactive prompts in automated pipelines (e.g., bridge API)
- Exits with error if --auto used without feature description or new-prompt.md
- Updated usage documentation in file header
oro-run with very easy tasks would get stuck
fix: defer GIT_CONFIG evaluation so .env values are read after loadEnv()

feat: add waitForServer helper, dev server startup guidance, fix chmod warning

- Add waitForServer() to browser-utils.js (retries with backoff until server responds)
- Add --wait-for-server and --server-timeout flags to verify-ui.js CLI runner
- Update all prompts (run, generate, feedback, init) to require dev server startup before browser tests
- Clarify Playwright is a Node.js library, not a separate CLI tool
- Remove unnecessary chmod call in oreo-run.js (shell:true makes it redundant)
- Silence postinstall chmod error for global npm installs

feat: add waitForServer helper and dev server startup guidance

- Add waitForServer() to browser-utils.js (retries with backoff until server responds)
- Add --wait-for-server and --server-timeout flags to verify-ui.js CLI runner
- Update all prompts (run, generate, feedback, init) to require dev server startup before browser tests
- Clarify Playwright is a Node.js library, not a separate CLI tool
- oro-init template now generates Playwright-aware creme-filling.md with server startup rules

fix: critical fs import bug and enforce mandatory Playwright browser testing

- Fix Fatal Error: fs is not defined in oreo-config.js (missing require)
- Strengthen all prompt templates to MANDATE automated browser tests for UI tasks
- Add explicit tool inventory (verify-ui.js, browser-utils.js) to agent

feat: add verify-ui.js CLI runner and browser-utils high-level helpers

Reduces token cost per UI verification by 3-5x. Agents can now run a
single command instead of generating full test scripts:

  node oroboreo/tests/reusable/verify-ui.js --url URL --selector SEL

New browser-utils.js helpers: verifyElementExists, verifyPageLoads,
verifyFormSubmission. Updated prompt templates in oreo-run, oreo-generate,
and oreo-feedback to prefer CLI runner. Added verify-ui.js to
syncReusableUtils for automatic propagation to existing projects.

fix: user-configurable git settings and accurate task count in PRs

- GIT_CONFIG now reads from env vars in oroboreo/.env instead of
  requiring edits to installed package code
- Fixed extractSessionSummary counting all checkboxes (including
  Human UI Verification items) instead of only **Task N:** entries

feat: add full Claude Opus 4.6 support

Updated model references and configurations across the codebase
to fully support Claude Opus 4.6.

fix: oro-init now creates oroboreo directory and copies .env.example

Previously oro-init assumed the oroboreo directory already existed,
causing silent failures on fresh installs. Now it:
- Creates the oroboreo/ directory if it doesn't exist
- Copies .env.example from the npm package to the user's oroboreo/ folder

feat: add per-model Foundry resource support for smart routing

Azure AI Foundry requires separate deployments for each Claude model.
This update adds support for model-specific resource configuration:
- ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_OPUS
- ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_SONNET
- ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_HAIKU

Smart routing now dynamically selects the correct Foundry resource
based on task complexity tags. Backward compatible with single
ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE configuration.

v1.0.6: Auto-fix shell permissions + use oro-* in CLI output

- Add postinstall script to chmod +x run-with-prompt.sh on Unix
- Update all CLI help/output to use oro-* commands instead of node paths

v1.0.6: Auto-fix shell script permissions on Linux/macOS

- Add postinstall script to chmod +x run-with-prompt.sh on Unix
- Fixes Permission denied error after npm install -g

v1.0.5: Fix NPM path resolution for all user files

- Use process.cwd() instead of __dirname for user files
- Fixes: .env loading, human-feedback.md, progress.txt, logs, archives
- Affects: oreo-feedback, oreo-generate, oreo-init, oreo-run, oreo-archive
- __dirname correctly retained for package scripts (run-with-prompt.bat/sh)
v1.0.4: Fix archive sorting, Linux support, and NPM .env loading
v1.0.3: Fix archive sorting, Linux support, and NPM .env loading
Bump to v1.0.3 - fix archive sorting
Feature: Ability to use Microsoft Foundry API through Azure

### Added
- **Playwright Support:** Added playwright as optional dependency for browser automation tasks
